Analysts expect Aerpio Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:ARPO) to report $-0.18 EPS on February, 6.After having $0.28 EPS previously, Aerpio Pharmaceuticals, Inc.’s analysts see -164.29 increased 4.02% or $0.08 $2.07. About 76,769 shares traded or 8.64% up from the average. Aerpio Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (NASDAQ:ARPO) has declined 64.37% downtrending. It has underperformed by 64.37% the S&P500.
Aerpio Pharmaceuticals, Inc., a biopharmaceutical company, focuses on developing and commercializing treatments for ocular diseases. $84.00 million. The company's lead product candidate is AKB-9778, a small molecule activator of the Tie2 pathway, which completed the Phase 2a clinical trial for the treatment of diabetic retinopathy. It currently has negative earnings. It also develops ARP-1536, a humanized monoclonal antibody that is in preclinical development stage for the treatment of diabetic vascular complications; and AKB-4924, a selective stabilizer of hypoxia-inducible factor-1 alpha, which has completed a single ascending dose clinical trial for the treatment of inflammatory bowel disease.
